findingDetails.title: Benchmark run index omits the newest run folder, including the run the release note cites as its evidence
The phase-014 release note misstates all three of its out-of-domain counts

results.summary: Version authority holds: SKILL.md:5, description.json:4, mode-registry.json:3 and ROUTER.md:9 all read 1.1.2.0, matching the newest changelog entry.

Criterion 5 still holds per mode but not for a combined three-mode request (R1-P1-001, R2-P1-001). The documentation evidence layer adds two accuracy defects: the run index omits the newest run folder and the release note misstates three out-of-domain counts.

noveltyJustification: Both findings are new to this lineage and neither restates a closed 014 item. The index omission is established by diffing the four run folders on disk against the three index rows, and the count misstatement by parsing results.csv with a quote-aware reader and counting each predicate: 9 earlier out-of-domain rows rather than 11, 6 routed before rather than 8, and 9 rows at advisor confidence 0.82 or above rather than 8. The ratio is 2 weighted P2 over 26 accumulated weighted findings.
